name: Grind Anything!
desc:
Wish for anything, toss it into the industrial grinder, and watch it get chewed up into satisfying pieces💥🧩✨

✅ Type wishes to create objects
💸 Earn cash by shredding (unique = BIG rewards!)
⚙️ Upgrade, experiment, and see what breaks the best!

Can you discover the most valuable shreds? 😈🔥💰
